title: Blood Pressure Variability Monitor
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), WHOOP recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body and blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, WHOOP, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=withings:measure measure_type=blood_pressure
| bin _time span=1w
| stats stdev(systolic) as sys_sd, avg(systolic) as avg_sys, avg(diastolic) as avg_dia by user _time
| where sys_sd>12 OR avg_sys>135 OR avg_dia>85
| sort - sys_sd
description: Tracks week-to-week blood-pressure stability and not just the average, surfacing those weeks where numbers are swinging around more than usual.
value: High variability can matter even when averages look only mildly elevated; the trend helps you separate an isolated reading from a pattern worth following up.
implementation: Export cuff readings from Withings or a similar device; review weekly variability and sustained elevated averages.
visualization: Weekly table of systolic variability with mean systolic and diastolic values.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when your blood-pressure readings start jumping around a lot or staying high for the week.
